propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a reminder when the command invokes grep-family tools (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) to guide agents toward Serena symbol search instead
The hook trigger must be a simple string match for grep-family commands with no pattern classification or path heuristics, and must accept false positives over false negatives
The reminder message must be 2-3 lines, non-blocking, and explain both the preferred Serena approach and the legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers)
The hook must emit JSON with additionalContext via hookSpecificOutput, omit permissionDecision to avoid blocking or suppressing permission prompts, and never exit non-zero
The hook implementation and its trigger logic must be testable via an automated test that executes against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope
The .claude/settings.json changes must merge the new hooks.PreToolUse entry while preserving the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from story C
